description: Reconstruct a distributed trace by collecting all log events matching a trace/request ID across multiple NDJSON files, sorted chronologically.

idField.description: Field name containing the trace/request ID

lineStartPattern.description: Regex that marks new log line start — enables multiline stack trace buffering

logFiles.description: Array of absolute paths to NDJSON log files

traceId.description: Trace/request ID value to search for

name: correlate_request
